finalOutput:
Created `snake_openrouter-minimax-minimax-m3_01.html` (17,462 bytes, 614 lines) — a complete single-file Snake game.

**Features implemented:**

| Requirement | Implementation |
|---|---|
| 30×30 grid | `GRID = 30` constant |
| Continuous 4-direction movement | `tick()` advances head each frame on `setInterval` |
| Grows on food | Snake array only pops tail when `food` not eaten |
| Wall/self collision = game over | `gameOver` flag checked in `tick()` |
| Keyboard controls | Arrow keys (P1) + WASD (P2); opposite-direction guard |
| CPU snake | `cpuDecide()` uses BFS shortest-path-to-food with fallback safety move |
| 3 modes | HvH, CPUvH, CPUvCPU (selectable in start menu) |
| Live score | Top HUD shows score(s) every render |
| Start menu | Mode-selection overlay, shown on load |
| Game over screen | Overlay with winner + final score |
| Restart keypress | `R` restarts from any state; `Space`/`Enter` confirms menus |

**Controls:**
- Menu: `1`/`2`/`3` to pick mode, `Enter` to start
- P1 (green): Arrow keys
- P2 (cyan, HvH mode): WASD
- Restart: `R`
- Pause: `P`

**CPU logic:** BFS from head to nearest food on the grid (treating both snakes' bodies as obstacles), picks the first step of the shortest safe path; if no food is reachable, picks the move that maximizes reachable open cells (flood-fill) to avoid trapping itself.

The file is self-contained — open it directly in any modern browser, no build step or server needed.

18. Both snakes share the same food - first to eat it grows
